snippet.title: Starbound Combat Update Trailer
snippet.description: This update majorly overhauls Starbound's combat system, introducing a wide variety of new weapons and fun secondary abilities that give you more options than ever before! You can also look forward to a slew of new monsters with their own unique behaviours, two new biomes, and hoverbikes you can ride with your friends!
